question_sw: Mwajiri anatoa cheti gani kwa mfanyakazi wakati anamaliza kazi ili kuthibitisha PAYE iliyokatwa?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anatoa Hati ya Kuacha Kazi au sehemu husika ya Fomu P9 inayoonyesha jumla ya mapato na PAYE iliyokatwa hadi tarehe ya kumaliza kazi. Thibitisha hati halisi inayohitajika na TRA. Pia, ifikapo Machi 31 ya mwaka unaofuata, mwajiri anatoa Fomu P9 ikionyesha mapato ya mwaka mzima na PAYE yote iliyokatwa. Mfanyakazi anahifadhi fomu hizi kwa matumizi ya return ya kodi ya mtu binafsi.
answer_en: The employer issues a Leaving Certificate or relevant part of Form P9 showing total earnings and PAYE deducted up to the date of leaving. Confirm the exact document required with TRA. Also, by 31 March of the following year, the employer issues Form P9 showing full-year earnings and total PAYE deducted. The employee retains these forms for their individual tax return.
question_en: What certificate does an employer give an employee when they leave employment to confirm the PAYE deducted?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — P45 and P9 forms

reasons: names "P9" as the Tanzanian alternative to a UK P45 -- "P9" is Kenyan (KRA) terminology, the same defect already corrected in paye_p9_deadline (Tier 2, 2026-08-31). The real TZ mechanism is the annual employment-income withholding certificate, Income Tax Act Cap.332 s.85(3)(b). Re-verified 2026-09-01.
